buffer_lifetime_synchronization.reason: The unchanged serial loop performs CopyIn, Compute, then CopyOut for every tile. Queue enqueue/dequeue pairs order producer and consumer stages; tensors are freed after their consuming operations, and the final store remains part of the kernel before same-stream completion.

complete_timing_scope.reason: The unchanged host has one kernel launch per callback. Timer events bracket the complete callback on its stream; the kernel's entire dynamic tile loop, including its final store, is inside that launch.

dynamic_tails.reason: Each block clamps its length to remaining elements; each iteration clamps count to at most 8192. Copies use that count, and a padded short copy fits its full-sized, 32-byte-aligned local buffer.

no_case_or_output_shortcuts.reason: The only candidate difference is the constant tile size. The unchanged kernel computes and stores every owned tile; no case lookup, golden output, skipped-work branch or additional launch path appears.

ownership_coverage_reduction.reason: The unchanged block length is ceil(n/blockNum). Block b owns [b*blockLength, min(n,(b+1)*blockLength)); its tile loop covers that interval once. There is no reduction or cross-block output sharing.

semantics_precision.reason: The sole change is tileElements from 4096 to 8192. Attribute preprocessing, float32 multiply/add/exp order, dtype casts, and the NaN/Inf computation path are unchanged from baseline.

ub_capacity_alignment.reason: At 8192 elements, the two depth-one queues use 65,536 bytes for float32; for either 16-bit dtype they use 32,768 bytes plus two 32,768-byte fp32 buffers, totaling 98,304 bytes. All slot sizes are 32-byte multiples, including capacity for padded tails, below the supplied 196,608-byte UB capacity. No additional local tensor is allocated in source; 98,304 bytes remain for implementation overhead. Compiler-reserved usage was not independently measured.

workspace_bounds.reason: The launch supplies no workspace pointer. The kernel accesses only its allocated input, output and tiling arguments; its scratch is local queue/buffer storage, not global workspace.
